item.title: Iran: ‘Nigeria in trouble too’ – Hakeem Baba-Ahmed
item.description: Amid the ongoing tension in Iran, former Adviser to President Bola Tinubu on Political Matters, Hakeem Baba-Ahmed, has said that Nigeria too is in trouble.
